=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2986-2990 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: On rc=3, `_mt_merge_lease_conflict_unlabel_due` checks a snapshot of the lease record (`MERGE_LEASE_STATE=held` plus `MERGE_LEASE_HOLDER_ALL_ROWS`), and the caller then deletes the label in a separate request. If another tick labels the same holder and releases it for a conflict in that gap, this tick's DELETE removes the marker from a PR that was just released for a conflict.
  WHY: Without the label, a later conflict on a changed head can release the same PR a second time, which breaks D6 ("released at most once per PR"). Reviewers disagree on severity: gemini rated it BLOCKER, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR, and the highest is used here. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 considered this window and did not report it, saying it needs three concurrent lease writers inside one API round-trip and could not show that this can happen.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2986-2991 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: For any rc other than 3 (`[ "${1:-}" = 3 ] || return 0`), the rollback deletes the conflict-released label. But `_merge_lease_cas_commit` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3386-3391) also returns 1 when the PATCH was refused and the follow-up `_merge_lease_read` failed, so whether the release landed is unknown. The callers at 2245-2263/2257-2259 and 2670-2681/2675-2677 still remove the label.
  WHY: If the release, or a concurrent winner's conflict release, actually landed, deleting the label lets the same PR be released for a conflict a second time on a later head. That breaks D6, and `test_release_write_failure_removes_the_label` locks in the unlabel-on-rc=1 behaviour. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same rc=1 case only as a hardening suggestion, calling it rare and limited in damage.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2986-2990 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On rc=3, the helper keeps the conflict-released label whenever the winning record no longer lists the holder. It never checks `MERGE_LEASE_SKIPS` for a `<pr>:<head>:released_conflict` entry, so the label stays even when the winner released the holder as `expired`, `revoked_idle`, `revoked_draft`, etc.
  WHY: `_merge_lease_has_conflict_released_label` then returns true, so a conflicting holder keeps its slot. That recreates the long conflicting hold this issue was meant to remove and uses up the PR's one conflict release (D6) without a real conflict release. `test_lost_race_keeps_the_label_a_winner_relies_on` (tests/test_merge_lease_ready_grant.py lines 296-305, `(_record(5, acquired=now, updated=now), True)` case) locks this in. Reviewers disagree on severity: luna and gemini rated it MAJOR, sonnet, minimax and glm rated it NIT, and the highest is used here.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:`_mt_merge_lease_conflict_unlabel_due()` rc=3 branch (called at lines 2257-2259 and 2675-2677) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: On a lost race (rc=3), the helper keeps the conflict-released label whenever the winning record no longer lists the holder, and never checks whether the winner released it for a conflict. It never reads `MERGE_LEASE_SKIPS`, which `_merge_lease_cas_commit` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3385-3389) fills through `_merge_lease_read` (pr_checks_lib.sh:3109). A real conflict release always leaves the entry `<pr>:<head>:released_conflict` (pr_checks_lib.sh:3007-3024; review_merge_train.sh:2241, 2659).
  WHY: If the winner released #4 as expired and granted #5, the label stays on #4. When #4 later conflicts, it keeps its slot and its one conflict release (D6) is spent. `test_lost_race_keeps_the_label_a_winner_relies_on` locks this in. Suggested fix: keep the label on rc=3 only when `MERGE_LEASE_SKIPS` matches `^<pr>:[0-9a-f]{40}:released_conflict$`, and update the test (about 3-4 lines).
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:`_mt_merge_lease_conflict_unlabel_due` rc!=3 branch (`[ "${1:-}" = 3 ] || return 0`) | hardening suggestion (no severity stated)
  PROBLEM: rc=1 from `_merge_lease_cas_commit` also covers "PATCH refused and the re-read failed" (pr_checks_lib.sh:3386-3391), when it is unknown whether the release landed.
  WHY: This needs two API failures in a row, so it should be rare, and the damage is limited to one extra conflict release on a later head. The reviewer says no fix is needed now; optionally, keep the label when rc=1 and `MERGE_LEASE_SHA` is empty. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Note: the reviewer judged the re-read-to-DELETE third-writer race not demonstrable, and recorded no task gaps (the ci.yml wiring and the `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW` fallback were checked and not counted).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2986-2990 (called at 2257-2259 and 2675-2677) and scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3863 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: On rc=3, the helper checks the lease record and the label DELETE is issued afterwards, so a race exists between the check and the delete.
  WHY: Another tick may add the label and release the same holder in between, and this tick's DELETE then strips the marker for a new conflict release, breaking the once-per-PR rule (D6).
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2245-2263 and 2670-2681 (inside `_mt_merge_lease_tick` and `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: On rc=1 (write failure), the rollback removes the conflict-released label even when the release outcome is unknown.
  WHY: `_merge_lease_write` can return 1 even if the lease record was updated. Removing the label then lets the same PR be released for a conflict a second time, violating the once-per-PR rule.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2986-2990 (called at 2257-2259 and 2675-2677) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The helper removes the label only if `MERGE_LEASE_STATE` is `held` and the holder is still in `MERGE_LEASE_HOLDER_ALL_ROWS`. If the winner released the holder for another reason (`expired`, `revoked_idle`), the label stays indefinitely.
  WHY: No `released_conflict` skip entry exists, but the label stays, which blocks a future real conflict release and can lead to long lease holds.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:`_mt_merge_lease_conflict_unlabel_due()` (lines 2986-2990; called at 2257-2259 and 2675-2677) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: On rc=3, the helper keeps the conflict-released label whenever the winning record no longer lists the holder, without checking `MERGE_LEASE_SKIPS` for a `<pr>:<head>:released_conflict` entry, so it stays after non-conflict releases (`expired`, `revoked_idle`).
  WHY: `_merge_lease_has_conflict_released_label` is then true, so the holder keeps its slot while conflicting and uses up its D6 release. `test_lost_race_keeps_the_label_a_winner_relies_on` locks in the keep-label path.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:`_mt_merge_lease_conflict_unlabel_due()` (lines 2986-2990) and rollback call sites 2257-2259, 2675-2677 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Two race windows. (a) For any rc other than 3, the helper returns 0 and the label is deleted, although `_merge_lease_cas_commit` can return 1 when the outcome is unknown. (b) On rc=3, another tick can label and conflict-release the holder between the snapshot (`MERGE_LEASE_STATE=held` + `MERGE_LEASE_HOLDER_ALL_ROWS`) and the separate DELETE.
  WHY: Both paths can leave a conflict-released holder without the `ai:merge-lease-conflict-released` marker, so the PR can be released a second time, breaking D6. `test_release_write_failure_removes_the_label` locks in the rc=1 unlabel behaviour.
